summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built embedded firmware for STM32 microcontrollers in bare-metal C (3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM) and FreeRTOS, with UART/I2C/SPI sensor interfaces, and designed and fabricated EAGLE PCBs. Resolved 11 hardware/software integration failures on a Jetson + Arduino system and manage code with Git, Python and Linux.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through calibration.
Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI-based real-time chroma keying without a green screen; produced full claims documentation and BOM.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; brought up UART and I2C sensor communication with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for revision control (version control) and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed microcontroller peripherals (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1) directly from datasheets in bare-metal C; achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Built Cortex-M4 embedded firmware with timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Sent control commands from YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to an STM32 over UART; implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 hardware/software integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) via TCA9548A I2C mux; implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++ driving five servos.
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a Linux systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation) with static IP networking over a WebSocket fabric.
